categories.main_business_segments: Trina Solar operates primarily in four business segments: photovoltaic (PV) products including PV module research, production, and sales; energy storage solutions covering large-scale ground stations, commercial and residential storage; system solutions encompassing mounting structures, distributed systems, centralized power stations, and related services; and digital energy services including new energy operation and maintenance and power generation businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leads in advanced PV technologies such as N-type i-TOPCon solar cells, HJT cells, and perovskite/silicon tandem cells, achieving multiple world records in efficiency and power output. It employs vertical integration in its supply chain, advanced manufacturing processes including large-size 210mm wafers, and innovative energy storage technologies like flexible liquid-cooled battery containers. R&D is supported by national key laboratories and focuses on high-efficiency cells, energy storage, smart tracking systems, and recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Trina Solar serves a global customer base across over 180 countries, including large energy companies, commercial and residential users, and distributed energy system clients. Key markets include China, Europe, the United States, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America. The company’s products and solutions cater to utility-scale power plants, commercial and industrial distributed generation, and residential rooftop installations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong global presence with regional headquarters in Switzerland, the USA, Singapore, and the UAE, and manufacturing bases in China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, and the Middle East. Its sales and project development span China, Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa, reflecting a comprehensive international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Trina Solar operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain, including silicon wafer production, solar cell manufacturing, module assembly, system integration, and energy storage solutions. It maintains a moderately vertically integrated supply chain with upstream control over silicon wafer production and downstream involvement in system solutions and digital energy services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-efficiency solar cells (N-type i-TOPCon, HJT, perovskite tandem), energy storage technologies, and smart tracking systems. It emphasizes R&D investment, patent development, and collaboration with academic and industry partners. Strategic focus includes expanding system solution offerings, digital energy services, and sustainable manufacturing practices such as full recycling of PV modules.
categories.revenue_model: Trina Solar generates revenue primarily through product sales of photovoltaic modules, energy storage systems, mounting structures, and integrated system solutions. Additional revenue streams include digital energy services such as operation and maintenance contracts and power generation from self-owned solar assets. The company also engages in EPC contracting and project development activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Trina Solar is a leading global PV manufacturer, ranked second globally in module manufacturing by Wood Mackenzie and consistently recognized as a Tier 1 supplier by BloombergNEF. It competes with major international PV companies and maintains a strong position through technological leadership, diversified product portfolio, and global supply chain and sales network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Trina Solar reported revenues of approximately RMB 80.28 billion, a 29.21% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.44 billion. Despite revenue decline due to industry price pressures, the company shipped over 70 GW of modules, expanded energy storage shipments beyond 10 GWh, and maintained strong cash flow from operations. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures representing nearly 7% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Trina Solar emphasizes its technological innovation, high-efficiency and high-power PV modules, comprehensive energy storage solutions, and integrated system offerings as key differentiators. Its products feature industry-leading efficiency, reliability, and sustainability credentials, including full recycling capabilities. The company’s global footprint, strong brand, and customer-centric, scenario-driven solutions provide tailored energy systems that enhance value for diverse end-users.
